description: This file defines a SplashScreen widget for a Flutter app, showing an app logo and navigating to either login or home screen based on authentication state.

classes.name: SplashScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a splash screen with logo and handles initial routing based on authentication status.

classes.name: _SplashScreenState
classes.description: State class for SplashScreen that manages navigation logic after app bootstrap.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the SplashScreen widget.

methods.name: didChangeDependencies
methods.description: Checks auth status and triggers navigation to the appropriate route after dependencies change.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the splash screen UI with gradient background, logo icon, app name, and progress indicator.
